english.title: Attempt to kidnap / false imprison a person with intent to commit a relevant sexual offence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to commit an offence, namely

(A)_[kidnapping,]_
(B)_[false imprisonment,]_

with the intention of committing a relevant sexual offence
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempt to commit an offence
with the intention of committing a relevant sexual offence

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 72 of, and Schedule 2 to, the Sexual Offences Act 2003 regarding the committing of this offence outside the UK by UK nationals / residents.
(ii) Where the offence is one committed by MEANS OTHER THAN kidnapping or false imprisonment see H5812-CJS Code SX03124
(iii) A person convicted of this offence is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act as follows:-
(a) where the offender was under 18 years of age where he is or has been sentenced in respect of the offence to imprisonment for a term of at least 12 months;
(b) in any other case, the intended offence was an offence against a person under 18 or the offender in respect of the offence or finding, is or has been sentenced to a term of imprisonment, detained in a hospital, or made the subject of a community sentence of at least 12 months. (Sch 3 paragraph 31).
